name: Show desktop
author: WinDock
description: The Windows 7 "Show desktop" sliver: a narrow strip at the end of the dock (or a small desktop glyph). A click shows the desktop (Win+D, a second click brings the windows back) or minimizes every window (Win+M), sent with SendInput.

settings.label: A click
settings.description: What a click does: show the desktop (Win+D; a second click brings the windows back, as in Windows 7) or minimize every window (Win+M). Default: show the desktop.

settings.label: Style
settings.description: A translucent strip in the theme's text colour that brightens under the pointer (the Windows 7 look), or a desktop glyph in an icon-sized slot (for other themes). Default: the strip.

settings.label: Strip width
settings.description: How wide the strip is along the dock (on a left or right dock: how tall). Default: 10 DIPs.
